description: Cash vs. store-credit recommendation for the authenticated user. Compares taking the buylist cash payout for their inventory against taking store credit (worth a bonus %) and spending it on their buy list. Returns the recommendation, the credit advantage, out-of-pocket each way, and the priced buy-list lines. Requires IWMM_API_KEY.

bonus.description: Store-credit bonus as a fraction (0.30 = +30%). Must be in [0, 2]; defaults to 0.30 (Card Kingdom).

name: get_cash_vs_credit
